verdict.rationale: Stripe documents that Issuing supports both commercial and consumer card programs ([stripe-issuing-docs-17], [stripe-issuing-probe-2]) on Visa and/or Mastercard ([stripe-issuing-docs-14]). Cards can also be attached to open-loop wallets via Treasury ([stripe-issuing-docs-26]), and a funded Issuing balance is described ([stripe-issuing-docs-9]). That shows breadth beyond a single prepaid rail, but the pack never explicitly names debit, prepaid, or credit card types. The community question about prepaid classification ([stripe-issuing-comm-2]) is only a question, not a contradiction. missing for 10: explicit documentation of debit vs prepaid vs credit card products, evidence of commercial credit and consumer credit programs specifically, independent corroboration of the supported card types.
